edit_ai.title: AI Human Detection
edit_ai.description: When enabled, motion images are sent to the inference service. Only images where a human is detected trigger an email. Events without an image are discarded. If the service is unreachable the email is sent anyway (fail-open).

error.ai_unreachable: Cannot reach the inference service. Check the URL and that docker compose is running.

edit_animal_config.title: Animal Detection — {camera}
edit_animal_config.description: When enabled, motion images that contain a matching animal also trigger an email. Leave the class list empty to alert on any animal.

edit_recording.title: Local Recording
edit_recording.description: Records a local video clip when a human is confirmed (never on raw/unfiltered motion, so a false positive never burns a clip). Applies to both the MQTT and ONVIF motion paths. Housekeeping (retention cleanup + low-disk-space pruning) runs automatically on its own schedule. Recordings are stored under /config/www — the only local path Home Assistant's camera.record service allows writing to without extra configuration.yaml setup, and it lives on real, host-persistent storage without requiring any extra Docker volume.
